drafts.title: Headline
drafts.help: The line under your name. Say what you do and what you build or help with, not only "Student".
drafts.template: [What you do] | [What you build or help with] | [Skill 1, Skill 2]
checklist: Says what I do, not only "Student"
Names what I build or help with
Uses plain words and true details

drafts.title: About section
drafts.help: Only the first lines show before "see more", so put your best sentence first.
drafts.template:
I am learning [your main skill] by building small [kind of tools] that [what they help with].

My latest project: [one sentence about a real project and what it does].

I am currently learning [next thing]. I am looking for [what you want next, in plain words].

You can contact me here on LinkedIn or at [email].
checklist: Starts with who I am and what I do now
Names a real project as proof
Says what I want next and how to contact me

drafts.title: Project post
drafts.help: Turn one finished project into a short post. Use fake data only.
drafts.template:
[A hook: one strong line about the problem or the result]

[The problem, in one or two short lines.]

So I built [what you built]. It:
- [step or feature 1]
- [step or feature 2]
- [step or feature 3]

Result: [what changed. Use a number only if it is true.]

What I learned: [one real lesson].

Code and notes: [link]

[A question for the reader?]

#Python #Automation
checklist: Says the problem in one or two lines
Says what I did in 3 or 4 short lines
The result is true, with a number only if it is real
Ends with what I learned and a question

drafts.title: Project README
drafts.help: The front page of your repository. Someone should understand it in one minute.
drafts.template:
# [Project name]

[One sentence: what it is.]

## The problem
[Why it exists: what was slow, messy or hard.]

## What it does
- [Feature 1]
- [Feature 2]
- [Feature 3]

## How to run it
1. Install Python 3.
2. [Where to put the input file, and what to name it.]
3. Open a terminal in the folder and type:

```
python [your_script].py
```

## Example output
```
[A few lines of real output. Use fake data.]
```

## What I learned
[One or two true lessons]

## Next steps
[What you want to add next]
checklist: A short list of what it does
Steps to run it that a new person can follow
What I learned and what is next
